reasons: The lake record identifies the case as United States v. Shaquille Robinson, U.S. Court of Appeals, 4th Cir. (en banc), year 2017, docket No. 14-4902.
The lake official citation is 846 F.3d 694, and the vendor-neutral citations listed are 2017 WL 280727 and 2017 U.S. App. LEXIS 1134.
residual_risks: The lake notes a caption mismatch accepted by case-name matching; canonical caption is United States v. Shaquille Robinson.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Use the canonical caption United States v. Shaquille Robinson as an alias or parenthetical disambiguator.

reasons: The opinion states that an officer making a lawful traffic stop with reasonable suspicion that an automobile occupant is armed may frisk that person for officer protection and scene safety.
The opinion expressly says it is inconsequential that the passenger may have had a concealed-carry permit.
The opinion states that the danger arises from the combination of a forced police encounter and a weapon, not from illegality of possession.

defect.problem: The disclosed lake record and opinion text do not verify that Robinson illustrates a circuit split. The page asserts a split and names other cases, but no disclosed authority records or opinion text for those cases are present to verify the split.
defect.proposed_fix: Remove or downgrade the home-role label unless the disclosed record includes supporting authority records or text establishing the split, such as Northrup and Black records or another verified split source.

reasons: The Robinson majority supports the Fourth Circuit rule, but it does not itself establish an inter-circuit split from the disclosed text.
The lake record has no progeny or split-support edges from which the circuit-split role can be verified.
residual_risks: The circuit split may be real, but it is not verifiable from the disclosed evidence for this review group.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: State only that Robinson supplies the Fourth Circuit en banc rule unless verified split authorities are added.

reasons: Treatment/currency is outside lens A, but the page treatment fields match the lake treatment stub: unverified validity, null as-of fields, unverified composite basis, no point overrides, and the frontier-stub scope note.
residual_risks: Good-law status and later treatment were not substantively reviewed under lens A.
